artifacts.title: Gold medal of an international computational biology society
artifacts.description: Given once a year to one person from sixty member countries; awarded to the beneficiary in 2021, with a citation naming their work on protein-folding models since 2014.

artifacts.title: Broadcast and newspaper coverage of the beneficiary
artifacts.description: A 2023 national public-radio segment and a 2020 front-page business-section article, both about the beneficiary and the adoption of their protein-folding models work.

artifacts.title: Program committee chair of the flagship computational biology conference
artifacts.description: Program chair of the field's largest annual conference in 2022, overseeing about three thousand submissions, after serving as area chair every year since 2016.

artifacts.title: Industry standard built on the beneficiary's protein-folding models design
artifacts.description: In 2019 a national standards body adopted the beneficiary's design as the reference approach to protein-folding models; six vendors have shipped products implementing it since 2020.

artifacts.title: Employment contract and industry pay benchmark
artifacts.description: Total pay has exceeded three times the median for senior computational biology professionals in an independent industry compensation benchmark each year since 2021.

artifacts.title: Reviewer acknowledgment letters
artifacts.description: Two letters thanking the beneficiary for reviewing four submissions to a protein-folding models workshop.

artifacts.title: Journal articles and preprints
artifacts.description: Three journal articles and two preprints on protein-folding models, with a combined twenty-five citations.

artifacts.title: Outstanding presentation prize
artifacts.description: A prize for the best student-track presentation at an annual computational biology meeting.
